_comment: Phrases that mean a posting is definitively closed, matched case-insensitively against a page's derived text. Each must be specific enough that it cannot appear on a page whose posting is live: "job not found" (a search widget's empty state) and "applications are closed" ("...for our internship program, but this role is open") were both removed for failing that test — the remainder falls through to the model, which costs a call and is the cheaper mistake. Each entry names an ATS or site the phrase was actually seen on, so an entry can be re-checked against a real page rather than guessed at. Keep these unambiguous: a false positive silently closes a live role, which is worse than paying for a model call. Matching normalizes curly quotes and whitespace first, so write phrases in plain ASCII.

phrases.phrase: this job is no longer available
this posting is no longer available
this job posting is no longer active
the job you are looking for is no longer open
this job ad is no longer active
